title: TSMC eyes US$22.6 billion Texas campus for 2nm chips
html:
TSMC is considering a US$22.6 billion semiconductor manufacturing campus in Texas, including about US$14 billion in machinery and equipment investment, as the chipmaker weighs Texas against Arizona for its next major US expansion.
